scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run check-types
scripts.fix: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check . --fix && bunx oxfmt && bunx oxlint --fix
scripts.check-types: uv run ty check apps/ingest/src apps/ingest/scripts && lerna run typecheck
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check . && bunx oxfmt --check && lerna run format:check
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t brb-web . && docker build -f apps/ingest/Dockerfile -t brb-ingest .
scripts.test: uv run python -m pytest . --ignore=refs -n 4 --dist loadfile -q && lerna run test
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && lerna run lint
